on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      tier:
        description: Current League-V4 seed tier (not historical match rank)
        type: choice
        default: CHALLENGER
        options: [CHALLENGER, GRANDMASTER]
      key_renewed:
        description: Manual key renewal confirmation; otherwise use recorded24h user window
        type: boolean
        default: false
      division:
        type: choice
        default: I
        options: [I, II, III, IV]
      patch:
        description: Exact match patch; blank pins first eligible patch
        type: string
        default: ''
  schedule:
    - cron: '17 3 * * *'

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read

concurrency:
  group: riot-power-collection-main
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  collect:
    # Secrets are used only on trusted default-branch code; never fork/PR/ref code.
    if: github.repository == 'kco994553-star/lol-coach' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event_name == 'schedule')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 25
    steps:
      - name: Check out trusted default branch
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: main
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - name: Install pinned runtime for aggregate hashing and validation
        run: python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check -r requirements-r3.txt
      - name: Recover previous trusted anonymous sufficient state before expiry
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/power-state" "$RUNNER_TEMP/power-output"
          python - <<'PY'
          import json, os, subprocess
          repo=os.environ['GITHUB_REPOSITORY']
          def api(path):
              result=subprocess.run(['gh','api',path],capture_output=True,text=True)
              if result.returncode: raise RuntimeError('STATE_RECOVERY_API_UNAVAILABLE')
              return json.loads(result.stdout)
          artifacts=api('repos/'+repo+'/actions/artifacts?name=riot-power-accumulator&per_page=100')['artifacts']
          artifacts=sorted(artifacts,key=lambda a:a['created_at'],reverse=True)
          selected=None
          for artifact in artifacts:
              if artifact['expired']:continue
              run=api('repos/'+repo+'/actions/runs/'+str(artifact['workflow_run']['id']))
              if run['head_branch']=='main' and run['path']=='.github/workflows/riot-power-collection.yml' and run['event'] in ('schedule','workflow_dispatch'):
                  selected=artifact;break
          if selected:
              result=subprocess.run(['gh','run','download',str(selected['workflow_run']['id']),'--repo',repo,
                  '--name','riot-power-accumulator','--dir',os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP']+'/power-state'],capture_output=True,text=True)
              if result.returncode:raise RuntimeError('STATE_RECOVERY_DOWNLOAD_UNAVAILABLE')
              print('ANONYMOUS_STATE_RECOVERED')
          else:
              print('NO_PREVIOUS_UNEXPIRED_TRUSTED_STATE; LEGACY_REAL50_SEED_ONLY')
          PY
      - name: Restore and refresh existing aggregates without any provider request
        run: |
          python scripts/collect_power_stats.py --publish-only --accumulator "$RUNNER_TEMP/power-state/power-accumulator.json.gz" --seed-data data/riot/2026-10-11/power-data.json.gz --aggregate-directory "$RUNNER_TEMP/power-output" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/power-output/power-data.json"
      - name: Resolve current official patch and Challenger or auxiliary-only collection policy
        id: policy
        env:
          EXPLICIT_PATCH: ${{ inputs.patch }}
          REQUESTED_TIER: ${{ inputs.tier || 'CHALLENGER' }}
          MANUAL_RENEWED: ${{ inputs.key_renewed }}
        run: |
          policy_args=(--patch "$EXPLICIT_PATCH" --tier "$REQUESTED_TIER" --aggregate-directory "$RUNNER_TEMP/power-output")
          if [[ "$MANUAL_RENEWED" == true ]]; then policy_args+=(--manual-renewed); fi
          python scripts/resolve_riot_collection.py "${policy_args[@]}"
      - name: Clear prior job rolling Riot rate window before fresh client
        if: steps.policy.outputs.enabled == 'true'
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          import time
          time.sleep(60)
          time.sleep(60)
          time.sleep(1)
          PY
      - name: Collect official KR seed and ASIA matches with bounded requests
        if: steps.policy.outputs.enabled == 'true'
        env:
          RIOT_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.RIOT_API_KEY }}
          COLLECTION_TIER: ${{ inputs.tier || 'CHALLENGER' }}
          COLLECTION_DIVISION: ${{ inputs.division || 'I' }}
          COLLECTION_PATCH: ${{ steps.policy.outputs.patch }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          args=(--diagnostics-output "$RUNNER_TEMP/power-output/riot-diagnostics.json" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/power-output/power-data.json" --movement-output "$RUNNER_TEMP/power-output/movement-data.json" --outcome-output "$RUNNER_TEMP/power-output/outcome-data.json" --accumulator "$RUNNER_TEMP/power-state/power-accumulator.json.gz" --aggregate-directory "$RUNNER_TEMP/power-output" --division "$COLLECTION_DIVISION" --max-matches 300 --max-requests 650 --max-players 40 --max-pages 1 --max-retries 2 --deadline-seconds 900)
          args+=(--tier "$COLLECTION_TIER")
          if [[ -n "$COLLECTION_PATCH" ]]; then args+=(--patch "$COLLECTION_PATCH"); fi
          python scripts/collect_power_stats.py "${args[@]}"
      - name: Print safe aggregate status only
        if: always()
        env:
          ACQUISITION_GATE: ${{ steps.policy.outputs.enabled == 'true' && 'ENABLED' || 'NOT_REQUIRED_OR_EXPIRED_NO_PROVIDER_CALLS' }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          import json, os
          from pathlib import Path
          path = Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP']) / 'power-output/power-data.json'
          if not path.exists():
              diagnostic_path = path.with_name('riot-diagnostics.json')
              if not diagnostic_path.exists(): diagnostic_path = path.with_name('riot-front-diagnostics.json')
              diagnostic = json.loads(diagnostic_path.read_text()) if diagnostic_path.exists() else None
              result = {'status': diagnostic.get('collection_status', diagnostic.get('status')) if diagnostic else 'OUTPUT_NOT_PRODUCED',
                        'reason': diagnostic.get('collection_reason', diagnostic.get('reasons')) if diagnostic else None, 'coaching_accuracy': None}
          else:
              from coach_v1.power_stats import validate_power_dataset
              data = validate_power_dataset(json.loads(path.read_text()))
              result = {'status': data['status'], 'real_matches': data['samples']['real_matches'],
                        'patch': data['source']['patch'], 'tier': data['source']['tier'],
                        'collection': data['source']['collection'], 'coaching_accuracy': None}
          result['acquisition_gate']=os.environ['ACQUISITION_GATE']
          diagnostic_path=path.with_name('riot-diagnostics.json')
          if diagnostic_path.exists():
              diagnostic=json.loads(diagnostic_path.read_text())
              result['current_run_collection_status']=diagnostic['collection_status']
              result['current_run_collection_reason']=diagnostic['collection_reason']
              result['user_key_expiry_attribution']=diagnostic['user_key_expiry_attribution']
          print('RIOT_AGGREGATE_RECEIPT_JSON=' + json.dumps(result))
          outcome_path = path.with_name('outcome-data.json')
          if outcome_path.exists():
              from coach_v1.outcome_stats import validate_outcome_dataset
              outcome = validate_outcome_dataset(json.loads(outcome_path.read_text()))
              print('OUTCOME_AGGREGATE_RECEIPT_JSON=' + json.dumps({'status': outcome['status'], 'real_matches': outcome['samples']['real_matches'], 'coaching_accuracy': None}))
          with Path(os.environ['GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY']).open('a') as output:
              output.write('Public-safe aggregate only; raw payloads and player identifiers are never uploaded.\n\n```json\n' + json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n```\n')
              output.write('\nState is restored/refreshed daily for90days. CHALLENGER primary; GRANDMASTER only insufficient same-patch auxiliary. No ownID/tier required. Recorded24h renewal window gates schedule; first401/403 stops that execution. Current seed tier is not historical participant rank.\n')
          PY
      - name: Retain public-safe aggregate for seven days
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: riot-power-aggregate
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/power-output/*.json
          retention-days: 7
          if-no-files-found: warn
      - name: Refresh private anonymous sufficient state for ninety days
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: riot-power-accumulator
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/power-state/power-accumulator.json.gz
          retention-days: 90
          if-no-files-found: error
'
